$description: popStrings (orchestral pop strings) pattern bank. Legacy has a single string style ('library'; config.json#defaultStyleMappings.stringPatterns maps every genre to ['library']); the genre dispatch + bpm-band filtering live INSIDE LibraryStringPatternGeneratorClass.js (the switch on parameters.genre, then `e.bpm==='any' || bpmLow<=bpm<=bpmHigh`). We model that as one style file per dispatched genre bucket (ballad / edm / organicVibes) and map each canonical genre to its bucket via genreStyles. Per-pattern bpmLow/bpmHigh (when bpm!=='any') drive the bpm-band filter in selectOrchestralPattern. Each pattern emits `noteRelative` events with octave-centering (adjustment = -12*round(avgPosition/numNotes/12), LibraryStringPatternGeneratorClass.js:70-99); the legacy bpm adjustmentFactor is fixed at 1.

$legacySource.styleMap: casperaki2-engine-js/api/v1.0/services/classes/config/config.json#defaultStyleMappings.stringPatterns (all genres -> ['library']; genre dispatch is internal: ballad->ballad, edm/schlager->edm, organicVibes/urban/accented->organicVibes)
